about_the_game:
Dreams of Changed: Poker is a more traditional take on a Texas Hold'em rules poker game, remininscent of classics like Poker Night with a transformation twist, playing against a variety of colourful characters each with their own quirks and playstyles. A mysterious matron has invited yourself, and a bunch of others through dreams to a mysterious game, as an ancient being's fascination with a more modern form of wagering, controls the fates of everyone brought there.

'Winner takes all' being very literal here, as the winner will be able to keep everyone to their form's desire, a focus on transformation as every character has a unique ending. Manage to make it through yourself, and have an oppurtunity to take on Tycha's trial, at a chance to know her intentions...

Features:-

  • Relaxing, simple poker gameplay with not too much twists to adapt to, whether to chill out to, or just learn for fun. Beginners to some experience recommended.

  • Games as fast or slow as you want! Play aggressive for faster experiences, or slowly bluff and grind out your opponents chip by chip! Losers that lose their stack with become part of the game itself changed into the very cards you play with!

  • 8 Original Characters to play with, each with their own pattern and style of gaming, as well as a unique 'boss' to encounter! Each character having their own ending cards if they're the victor.

  • Support to add additional characters within the local files, help in a text file.

  • Different stages, tables and card skins to earn via levelling up. Each stage with their own music tracks and vibe.

  • A challenge mode after showing at least every opponent their place. Take on everyone in a knockout tournament and gain the interest of the mysterious dealer herself!

content_descriptors.notes:
The game features a heavy focus on simulated poker, a form of gambling which may be unsuitable to certain audiences.

Also a focus of content related to anthro (furry) designs, revealing but not explicit outfits, and transformation.
